scope: Direct positive counterexamples in the initial and relational SQLite schedules.
original: Write the original request and its measured failure before making any reduction request. Keep the original record unchanged even if the reducer crashes or times out.
confirmation: Repeat the original failure once. A strictly smaller direct request must pass the same construction and oracle premises and exhibit the same comparison signal twice. Preserve the exact confirmed failure and request. Do not reduce a negative or analyzed case through this mechanism.
time: Use the worker's original absolute execution deadline. Reduction cannot extend execution or change the result of a required test.
retention: Record the reduction separately with the original artifact digest and every attempted probe classification. Failures to reproduce stay visible and never override the original error.
controls: Confirm a valid smaller request and reproduce its exact comparison signal
Reject a proposed request that fails a construction premise
Reject a request that only mismatches once
Preserve the original request when reduction generation raises
